from.place: The common-stage coefficient descent in the algebraically closed naturality clause.

source.place: Deligne, Weil II, (1.1.3) and (1.1.7), pp. 150–151; original coefficient-extension clause and proof step 3 of lem-weil-frobenius-point-transport-natural. Explicit normalization is agent-written.

title: The canonical common-stage Frobenius components form a natural transformation
statement: For a finite-field datum D, a prime l distinct from its characteristic, and an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l, there is a natural transformation from the small algebraically closed point fibre to the composite of common-stage Frobenius pullback and that fibre. Each component is heterogeneously equal to the literal stage-represented Frobenius point transport of def-weil-frobenius-point-transport. Source and target object identifications are the specified ones of the point fibre and common-stage pullback, not additional hypotheses.

proof.text: At each finite coefficient field rationalize the integral restriction-comparison natural transformation. Exact derived localization gives integral naturality; the pure-tensor formulas for the rational fibre and pullback extend it to arbitrary rational morphisms. The specified rational scalar square supplies compatibility under every coefficient-field inclusion.

Apply rational_family_common_stage_naturality to that family. Supply unit, tower, representative-action and enlargement formulas from PointCompositeComparison.tower_and_actions. Its stage component is the coefficient extension by Shrink.algEquiv followed by the fixed stage functor applied to the rational component, exactly the definition of frobeniusPointTransportQbar. The canonical object equalities give HEq. This includes the zero object and identity field extensions.

proof_origin.place: R1, 2026-10-25: isolate the common-stage descent portion of the original algebraically closed naturality clause.

lean.statement:
theorem frobeniusPointTransportQbar_naturalTransformation
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω] :
    letI := frobeniusPointPrimeInvertible D l hl
    ∃ τ : pointQbarFibre D l hl Ω ⟶
        commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω (frobeniusPointIso D).hom ⋙
          pointQbarFibre D l hl Ω,
      ∀ A, HEq (τ.app A) (frobeniusPointTransportQbar D l hl Ω A)
